On the anniversary of George Floyd’s murder, I’m not surprised at the number of gentrifiers in #yeahTHATgreenville putting out their #BlackLivesMatter signs in faux solidarity.
Racial equality is more than performative action. It’s sacrifice. Allyship is more deed than words.

I support and love #BlackLivesMatter as a movement. They have changed this nation for the better.
But #BLM as an organization is inherently corrupt and exploitive. Patrisse Cullors is a con artist who profiteers off the suffering of Black families.
